notes: Open seat: John Cornyn (R) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Texas's open Senate seat has become one of the closest races of 2026. With John Cornyn retiring, Democrat James Talarico faces Republican Ken Paxton, and recent polls from Emerson, CBS/YouGov, Verasight, and Beacon all show Talarico narrowly ahead, with averages clustering around a 2-point Democratic margin. Prediction markets price Talarico near 64%, and most expert raters call the race a Tossup, though a few lean Democratic.

Talarico holds a large fundraising advantage, while Paxton has drawn heavy outside opposition spending. Endorsements from Bush family members highlight Paxton's crossover weakness, though Texas's Republican-leaning electorate keeps the race competitive. The forecast gives Talarico a modest edge with meaningful uncertainty.
